fusions.name: Binding Word
fusions.desc: Speaks a word that deals 9 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Suppressed] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Perfect Recitation
fusions.desc: After a 1 second recital, looses 4 bolts at once, spread apart, each of which deals 12 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Standing Cast
fusions.desc: Increases your cast speed by 25% for 12 seconds. A guardian fights beside you for 15 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Spoken Shield
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
